codeReview.summary: The ContactsSection implementation fully covers all 7 requirements from the feature description. It implements all 4 states (empty/running/success/error) with correct transitions, contact cards showing name/title/department/LinkedIn, error preservation of prior contacts, POST to /api/contacts/find, and onComplete/onStateChange callbacks. The code follows the same patterns as ResearchSection (the reference sibling component), uses the shared SectionState type from types.ts, and integrates cleanly with the BriefRunController's externalState mechanism. The implementation is clean, consistent with project conventions (lucide-react icons, shadcn/ui primitives, Tailwind styling, getBriefData for refresh), and handles edge cases well (running with prior data shows faded cards, success with zero contacts shows a distinct message).

issues.description: The `disabled={isRunning}` on the empty-state Find Contacts button is redundant since `isRunning` is derived from `state === 'running'` and this branch only renders when `state === 'empty'`. Not a bug, but unnecessary code. The same pattern exists in ResearchSection, so it's consistently applied across sections.

The API response is cast as `{ success: boolean }` without runtime validation. If the API shape changes, this would silently pass. However, this is consistent with how ResearchSection handles its API responses, and the API route is stable (pre-existing, off-limits per AGENTS.md).
